subject: Vendor security questionnaire — prefill & routing questions
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Morris <samuel.morris@veridian.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor security questionnaire — prefill & routing questions

Hi Sam — great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a few asks to get the questionnaire moving: 

1) SIG vs CAIQ: you mentioned your security team prefers SIG/CAIQ. Can you confirm whether you want us to fill your template (attached Veridian_SIG_Template.xlsx) or if you want a Redwood-prefill bundle (we can send our prefill as an XLSX/CSV)?

2) SOC 2 scope: you asked about SOC 2 — Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II that covers hosted API (production systems). I attached a one-page summary (SOC2-TypeII-summary-2025.pdf). Please confirm whether that satisfies the immediate ask or if your reviewers need the full report and SOC 2 audit letter.

3) Data residency & GDPR/HIPAA: you said EU customers will need residency checks. Do you want evidence for EU region routing only or full answers on data processing and BAA/HIPAA posture? If HIPAA is in scope we will need to confirm BAA status and evidence ownership (we typically route that through legal).

4) Evidence owners & timeline: to avoid back-and-forth, who on your side will own evidence intake? If you share an estimated timeline (e.g., 2–3 weeks for procurement review) we can prioritize the prefill and designate internal owners: Karthik for technical controls, Laura for policy/attestation, and I will coordinate procurement/sales items.

Next steps I propose: 
- You confirm SIG vs Redwood prefill by EOD Wed (07/08).
- If SIG, please send the latest Veridian_SIG_Template.xlsx (your attachment was the wrong format on the call). We can return a prefilled file in 48–72 hrs depending on scope.
- If HIPAA/BAA needed, loop in procurement/legal and we’ll prepare the BAA draft.

Attached: Redwood_SIG_Prefill_Template.xlsx (blank prefill we use), and the SOC2 one-pager.

Thanks — short note back will keep the timeline tight.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_Prefill_Template.xlsx; SOC2-TypeII-summary-2025.pdf

From: Samuel Morris <samuel.morris@veridian.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@veridian.ai
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor security questionnaire — prefill & routing questions

Hi Logan — thanks for the summary and the one-pager. Quick answers from our side: 

1) SIG preferred — that's our standard. I'll attach the most recent template in a follow-up email (procurement uses a locked XLSX). We want you to prefill as much as possible.

2) SOC 2: the one-pager is helpful. Our security reviewer will request the full SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter if available. For a fast start, the prefill + SOC 2 summary is usually enough to move to the technical review, but budget/contract cannot proceed without the full report.

3) HIPAA/GDPR: HIPAA is in-scope for this procurement (we're evaluating the product for a healthcare line). We will need BAA confirmation before production access. GDPR data residency: for now we only need a data-processing description and confirmation of EU hosting options; proof of EU-region hosting is not required in the first phase.

4) Evidence owner: procurement@veridian.ai will coordinate contract/BAA. Security reviewer is me (samuel.morris@veridian.ai) and I will own the SIG intake. Timeline: procurement is targeting a 3-week review window starting when we receive the prefilled SIG + SOC 2 report.

Please prefill the SIG and send the file back by Thu (07/09) if possible; procurement will then push to legal/security. If you need a point of contact in legal, I can introduce you to our counsel.

Thanks — attaching Veridian_SIG_Template_v2.xlsx in a separate message.

Best,
Sam
Senior Security Program Manager
Veridian AI

Attachments: (sent separately) Veridian_SIG_Template_v2.xlsx

- Laura: will own policy attestations, SOC 2 artifacts, and coordinate with Legal for BAA draft if required. Laura to confirm whether we need to pull the full SOC 2 report or if a bridge letter is already available in our vault.
- Logan: continue owning procurement timeline and introductions to Veridian legal if Sam requests counsel intro.

2) SOC2-TypeII-summary-2025.pdf (make available now) and request for the full SOC 2 report issuance (secure download link if required).
3) BAA cover note if procurement confirms HIPAA in-scope.
